2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch optimizes the zswap writeback process by dropping cold folios from the LRU as soon as writeback completes, rather than leaving them on the list for reclaim to find and free later. This is done by marking the folio PG_dropbehind, which allows the swap dropbehind path to free it once writeback ends. The patch also handles synchronous-IO devices by dropping the folio inline instead of waiting for the end of writeback.
